name: compiler-rt
description: LLVM runtime support libraries (builtins, sanitizers, profiling) built as a standalone component against the already-installed LLVM/Clang 21.1.8.
build: cmake -G Ninja -S llvm-project-21.1.8.src/compiler-rt -B llvm-project-21.1.8.src/compiler-rt/build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D LLVM_CONFIG_PATH="$PREFIX/bin/llvm-config"
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
